text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later... In the distance,
I caught sight of her heading toward the
starting gates alongside Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I know you've had a lot on your mind lately,
but I won't go easy on you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If I wanted that,
I wouldn't have challenged you—hm?
......

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...? What's the matter, C.B.?
Ah, is that...
the Trainer who's been so eager about you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
They took really good care of me when I had
that cold.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Rudolf.
Why is it that you can run for the sake of
others?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd hear such a question from
you.
Did you find yourself wanting to run for
someone else?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No way. It's just... I got curious,
wondering
what that must feel like, is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Soon enough, the race began.
I rushed over to the stands and clung to
the fence.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(...If I were just a little more
open-minded,
would I have agreed to make him my Trainer
right away?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(...If I were just a little more
open-minded,
would I have agreed to make her my Trainer
right away?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(If only I were a horsegirl who could run
for something's sake...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf took the lead,
and the gap between them slowly
began to widen. Before long,
they approached the third corner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf accelerated once more,
pulling even further ahead of Mr. C.B.
choice_data_list: (Is she off her game because she j...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as the thought crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. sank her body low into the track.
She dug deep, lowering her center of gravity,
and before I could even catch my breath—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(—Ah,
but right now... none of that matters!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(Right here, right now,
all that matters is...!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She surged forward,
as if leaving everything behind.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Heh, haha, ahahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(This is fun, so fun, so insanely fun,
I can't get enough of it!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(I don't need anything else,
nothing else could ever top this...!
This is it, this is what it's all about—!)

text_block_list.name: C.B. & Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaaaahhhhh—!!
Haaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, neck and neck,
the two of them crossed the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it,
I had sunk to the ground.
I had no idea who won;
all that remained was sheer exhilaration.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! What's wrong, you okay?
Don't tell me I passed my cold onto
you...?
choice_data_list: No... Your running was just so ama...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way,
you really got weak in the knees?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it,
that's exactly what I thought the first time
I saw her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the imaginable to the downright
unthinkable—
Mr. C.B.
could transcend every dream out there.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Anything, huh...
...Oh,
right.
You said you wanted the Classic Triple Crown,
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She seemed to remember what I'd said when
I first scouted her.
Even so,
bringing up the "Triple Crown" back then
had only been one example.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that I just wanted to put into
words
the boundless potential I felt within Mr.
C.B.
choice_data_list: You're someone who makes people dream.
You're someone who makes people dream.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Not glory... but dreams?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. blinked a few times at my words.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...If I run, does that let you dream?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not about "accolades" or "results."
You possess a brilliance far more
fundamental—
something capable of guiding a person's life.
When I told her that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not about "accolades" or "results."
You possess a brilliance far more
fundamental—
something capable of guiding a person's life.
When I told her that—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...That's pretty amazing.
You say some incredible things,
you know that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later that evening,
Mr. C.B. invited me out for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Man,
this place always feels so great.
...Might've been a while since I last came
here with someone.
choice_data_list: What made you want to take a walk ...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf told me before, you see.
She said a Trainer is someone who brings
what you can't create on your own.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It didn't really click back when she said
it...
but hearing your talk about dreams—
about the dream you see in me—
made me realize.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
......
You know,
I'm really no good with being tied down.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's being forced into something or
having expectations piled on me.
Running a race for someone else's sake,
or for some grand purpose...
I just can't do it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I know I can't do it now,
and I'm pretty sure I won't ever be able to
in the future, either.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't want to make my Trainer put up
with that, either.
If I was going to sign a contract,
our interests had to align.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's why I could never settle on a
Trainer.
But—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
......If all you want is to just dream
through me,
then that feels like a perfect fit.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Neither of us has to hold back. Plus,
it feels really comfortable.
It's this strange tailwind that I could
never whip up on my own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. narrowed her eyes with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You keep dreaming through me,
and I'll keep running however I like.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If that works for you,
have the contract ready.
Looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even reply,
she gave a light wave and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I hurriedly chased after her,
pulling the contract out of my bag.
And so began my days of dreaming by her
side.
